title: Sordland/Turn01/A_PoliticalOverview
description: Lucian Galade and Petr Vectern update you on the political situation and discuss on a strategy for maintaining popularity and fulfilling election promises. Petr Vectern seems to be very euphoric while Lucian Galade is thoughtful about the future of the administration.

entries.speaker: START
entries.title: START

entries.speaker: INPUT
entries.title: input

entries.speaker: OUTPUT
entries.title: output

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door swung open and Lucian Gala..."
entries.dialogueText: The door swung open and Lucian Galade, my chief strategist, walked in. He was a compact man with sharp, birdlike features. After briefly surveying the room from wall to wall, he sat down, poured a glass of water and opened his briefcase in a series of quick, graceful movements.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr Vectern arrived a couple of mi..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr Vectern arrived a couple of minutes early and sat across from me. He was struggling to hold back his smile.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“But, hey, back in university, did..."
entries.dialogueText: “But, hey, back in university, did you ever imagine we would be sitting here in the Maroon Palace? We have to celebrate this great victory.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is not the time to celebrate,..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is not the time to celebrate, Petr. We have work to do.”
entries.menuText: “This is not the time to celebrate, Petr. We have work to do.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will celebrate at the inaugural..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will celebrate at the inaugural ball. Just hang in there until the evening.”
entries.menuText: “We will celebrate at the inaugural ball. Just hang in there until the evening.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's celebrate then. I got my han..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's celebrate then. I got my hands on something special for us. An Erlory Maroon 30-year-old.”
entries.menuText: “Let's celebrate then. I got my hands on something special for us. An Erlory Maroon 30-year-old.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Looking forward to it. Evelyn hope..."
entries.dialogueText: “Looking forward to it. Evelyn hopes to congratulate you in person there.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good to know. It's been some time..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good to know. It's been some time since the last time I saw her."
entries.menuText: “Good to know. It's been some time since the last time I saw her."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm sure the kids would love to se..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sure the kids would love to see their Uncle Petr for the first time as the Vice President.”
entries.menuText: “I'm sure the kids would love to see their Uncle Petr for the first time as the Vice President.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I think it was Franc's birthday. W..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think it was Franc's birthday. We've barely had enough time for our families over these past months, haven't we?”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“That is great to hear! It's crazy..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is great to hear! It's crazy how fast the two have grown up. You are a good father.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr had a wistful look in his eyes..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr had a wistful look in his eyes. He and Evelyn had never been able to have kids of their own. During our campaign, the opposition had floated the rumor that he'd fathered illegitimate children during his wilder years, but it had never been substantiated.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Yes... I agree. We've got things t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes... I agree. We've got things to do today. We can let loose at the ball.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Gentlemen.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Gentlemen.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We'll be talking about our politic..."
entries.dialogueText: “We'll be talking about our political strategy for this term. Lucian and I had a meeting with the party and the reformists."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We mostly see eye to eye, but I wo..."
entries.dialogueText: “We mostly see eye to eye, but I would want to know what you think.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's see if I see eye to eye.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's see if I see eye to eye.”
entries.menuText: “Let's see if I see eye to eye.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Great. Let's go over this when Luc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Great. Let's go over this when Lucian arrives.”
entries.menuText: “Great. Let's go over this when Lucian arrives.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The tall-case clock in the room str..."
entries.dialogueText: The tall-case clock in the room struck three o'clock.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Hello, Petr.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hello, Petr.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Damn. You are exactly on time.""
entries.dialogueText: “Damn. You are exactly on time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian then turned towards me. He v..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian then turned towards me. He very slightly bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Another important point. We must b..."
entries.dialogueText: “Another important point. We must be aware of the Lotherberg Group. The Oligarchs convene under this organization to influence economic policies. Konrath Koronti led it for a long time before falling ill. The new leader is Mr. Walter Tusk."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“As far as I know, Konrath's son Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: “As far as I know, Konrath's son Marcel has strong ties to this group. His influence could definitely be an asset for us. But I'm sure he'll want something in return."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am aware of Mr. Koronti's wide n..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am aware of Mr. Koronti's wide network. That could come in handy.”
entries.menuText: “I am aware of Mr. Koronti's wide network. That could come in handy.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The Group's influence is an import..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Group's influence is an important force. One that we should use to our administration's advantage.”
entries.menuText: “The Group's influence is an important force. One that we should use to our administration's advantage.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That group is dependent on our eco..."
entries.dialogueText: “That group is dependent on our economic policies. They can't move a finger without us.”
entries.menuText: “That group is dependent on our economic policies. They can't move a finger without us.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I wouldn't be so optimistic. The c..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't be so optimistic. The capital they represent could do a lot of damage if it was diverted.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian took notes."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian took notes.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We'll see each other at the ball,..."
entries.dialogueText: “We'll see each other at the ball, then."
entries.menuText: “We'll see each other at the ball, then."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Definitely!""
entries.dialogueText: “Definitely!"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Let's move on with the meeting .""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's move on with the meeting ."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope things are looking good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I hope things are looking good.”
entries.menuText: “I hope things are looking good.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“According to reports, some members..."
entries.dialogueText: “According to reports, some members of the National Business Council are in their pockets. Tusk and the Group will surely try to bribe us in exchange for special economic protections.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at Petr."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at Petr.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: GameCondition.Turn01_A_PoliticalOverview = true

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“If we can get them to side with us..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we can get them to side with us. It all depends on what benefits we can offer and what the leader wants."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We just need to be careful with hi..."
entries.dialogueText: “We just need to be careful with him. He looks like the lesser evil, but it could very quickly turn out to be the other way around.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We need to tread carefully on all..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to tread carefully on all sides with all power players to survive our term. I need to underline the seriousness of the situation.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“This concludes our political brief..."
entries.dialogueText: “This concludes our political briefing for today. Our next meeting will be about our media strategy.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian and Petr bid their farewells..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian and Petr bid their farewells and left. A mysterious amount of smoke was rising far away on the horizon.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Let's start by evaluating our curr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's start by evaluating our current situation."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It may create issues for us, yes.""
entries.dialogueText: “It may create issues for us, yes."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“However, with the reformists gaini..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, with the reformists gaining more popularity, we may not be in a position to stand against them."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The majority of the Sordish people..."
entries.dialogueText: “The majority of the Sordish people demand change. They are more concerned about the economy than the Constitution, but they blame the system for their problems."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It will not be easy.""
entries.dialogueText: “It will not be easy."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""People are losing their trust in o..."
entries.dialogueText: "People are losing their trust in our democracy. Why do you think radicals like Bernard Circas are becoming more popular? Everyone's expecting us to bring the change the last government did not."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I agree with the reformists. Our r..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree with the reformists. Our responsibility is to democratize our broken system."
entries.menuText: “I agree with the reformists. Our responsibility is to democratize our broken system."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need to listen to the people if..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to listen to the people if we want to serve this country."
entries.menuText: “We need to listen to the people if we want to serve this country."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We will need many allies against t..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will need many allies against the Old Guard in the government."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If we lose power, we won't be able..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we lose power, we won't be able to execute the changes we need to make for the good of the country."
entries.menuText: “If we lose power, we won't be able to execute the changes we need to make for the good of the country."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's exactly what we campaigned..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's exactly what we campaigned for. A true change that will move the country forward."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Lucian. How are you?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Lucian. How are you?”
entries.menuText: “Lucian. How are you?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Glad to see you, Lucian.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Glad to see you, Lucian.”
entries.menuText: “Glad to see you, Lucian.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's not waste any time. Lucian,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's not waste any time. Lucian, go ahead with the overview.”
entries.menuText: “Let's not waste any time. Lucian, proceed with the overview.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It is a privilege to be here, sir...."
entries.dialogueText: “It is a privilege to be here, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I am ready and able, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: “I am ready and able, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As you wish, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“A comprehensive reform that would..."
entries.dialogueText: “A comprehensive reform that would make the reformists happy would mean maintaining a balance between all branches of government."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I agree. The Old Guard won't like..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. The Old Guard won't like this, though."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We need to work with the Supreme C..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to work with the Supreme Court one way or the other."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Which means removing your absolute..."
entries.dialogueText: “Which means removing your absolute veto as well. The reformists demand that all loopholes in the Constitution are closed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We'll need a comprehensive bill to..."
entries.dialogueText: “We'll need a comprehensive bill to balance the power structure more fairly."
entries.menuText: “We'll need a comprehensive bill to balance the power structure more fairly."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The Old Guard will do its best to..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Old Guard will do its best to preserve the Constitution. Chief Justice Hawker and his allied judges have a great influence over the Supreme Court, which will be tough to break."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. Ricter managed to persuade man..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Ricter managed to persuade many members of Assembly to give their support for drafting a new Constitution. Reformist politicians are quickly increasing in number."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The Court also has the final say o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Court also has the final say over constitutional legislation. Without their approval, we cannot even change it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“While the reformist wing inside ou..."
entries.dialogueText: “While the reformist wing inside our party is still a minority, they could have a tri-partisan majority in the assembly, especially if they unite under Frens Ricter."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I agree. They have too much power..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. They have too much power over Sordish politics."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We must break the power of the Sup..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must break the power of the Supreme Court one way or another."
entries.menuText: “We must break the power of the Supreme Court one way or another."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The reformists' demands are clear...."
entries.dialogueText: "The reformists' demands are clear. They want to limit the President's veto powers, ensure that the Supreme Court is independent and take away the Court's right to vote on constitutional amendments."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I support the reformists. We need..."
entries.dialogueText: “I support the reformists. We need a proper balance of power in this country."
entries.menuText: “I support the reformists. We need a proper balance of power in this country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd rather not go against them. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'd rather not go against them. The risks are too high."
entries.menuText: “I'd rather not go against them. The risks are too high."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I agree, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: “I agree, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“True. But we can't let the Old Gua..."
entries.dialogueText: “True. But we can't let the Old Guard manipulate us and then backstab us, like they did with Alphonso."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We must listen to their demands. O..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must listen to their demands. Otherwise we are no different than the previous administrations."
entries.menuText: “We must listen to their demands. Otherwise we are no different than the previous administrations."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I won't allow them to influence me..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't allow them to influence me. We will shape our own future."
entries.menuText: "I won't allow them to influence me. We will shape our own future."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We need to take away their vote in..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to take away their vote in constitutional legislation. It is absurd that they get to vote for bills when they aren't even elected."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I agree. We can't ignore the winds..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. We can't ignore the winds of change, after all."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We can figure it out. Our party st..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can figure it out. Our party still holds 130 out of 250 seats in the Assembly. We've got the power."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We cannot allow obstructionists to..."
entries.dialogueText: “We cannot allow obstructionists to exist.”
entries.menuText: “We cannot allow obstructionists to exist.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Looks like we have many challenges..."
entries.dialogueText: “Looks like we have many challenges ahead.”
entries.menuText: “Looks like we have many challenges ahead.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We can't underestimate this situat..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can't underestimate this situation."
entries.menuText: “We can't underestimate this situation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will write a more democratic Co..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will write a more democratic Constitution with the reformists."
entries.menuText: “We will write a more democratic Constitution with the reformists."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The new Constitution should give t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The new Constitution should give the President wide-ranging powers to lead Sordland into the future."
entries.menuText: “The new Constitution should give the President wide-ranging powers to lead Sordland into the future."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We could work with the Old Guard t..."
entries.dialogueText: “We could work with the Old Guard to protect our existing extensive powers."
entries.menuText: “We could work with the Old Guard to protect our existing extensive powers."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How can we come out of this in the..."
entries.dialogueText: “How can we come out of this in the best shape?"
entries.menuText: “How can we come out of this in the best shape?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's what we've been preparing f..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what we've been preparing for internally. Don't forget that promise is what got us elected."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The key thing here will be strengt..."
entries.dialogueText: "The key thing here will be strengthening the power of the Assembly, which we already lead with a majority."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you suggest we do, then?""
entries.dialogueText: “What do you suggest we do, then?"
entries.menuText: “What do you suggest we do, then?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It will be tough to persuade our b..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be tough to persuade our base if we work with Ricter and his band of reformists. But everyone agrees we need a new Constitution."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Cut it out, you two. Are you with..."
entries.dialogueText: “Cut it out, you two. Are you with me or not?"
entries.menuText: “Cut it out, you two. Are you with me or not?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That will not be accepted by the r..."
entries.dialogueText: “That will not be accepted by the reformists. This draft has been created with the advice of both our party and PFJP members."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's very bold. Then we must sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very bold. Then we must start with eliminating the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional legislation and perhaps take their immunity away."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“You would also be burning bridges..."
entries.dialogueText: “You would also be burning bridges with the Reformists and the Old Guard."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Don't forget the reformists want u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget the reformists want us to address the loopholes in the presidential veto system."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You must remember that we promised..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must remember that we promised people a democratic Constitution during the elections."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""How? You know the public wants us..."
entries.dialogueText: "How? You know the public wants us to enact extensive reforms. And how do we know if the Old Guard would support you?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian opened his dossier."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian opened his dossier.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""If we go against the demands of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we go against the demands of the people, the reformists will be furious. It could backfire."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you suggest we do?""
entries.dialogueText: “What do you suggest we do?"
entries.menuText: “What do you suggest we do?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I don't think you should take the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think you should take the risk, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You might be right.""
entries.dialogueText: “You might be right."
entries.menuText: “You might be right."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Only a strong administration can m..."
entries.dialogueText: “Only a strong administration can make Sordland great."
entries.menuText: “Only a strong administration can make Sordland great."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will not limit my veto powers. W..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will not limit my veto powers. We need them."
entries.menuText: “I will not limit my veto powers. We need them."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Very well. We will begin to explor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. We will begin to explore how to realistically pass such a constitutional change."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They can remain. Some reform is be..."
entries.dialogueText: “They can remain. Some reform is better than none."
entries.menuText: “They can remain. Some reform is better than none."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As you wish. We will move forward..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish. We will move forward on that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Of course, it will be looked at in..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, it will be looked at in detail."
entries.menuText: “Of course, it will be looked at in detail."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That is true, but if we don't evol..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is true, but if we don't evolve we might become part of the problem."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""However, I must stress that I am n..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I must stress that I am not for this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Yes, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Second, the President's absolute v..."
entries.dialogueText: “Second, the President's absolute veto will be taken away. This can be replaced with a limited veto system by fixing the current loopholes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We must draft a bill to destroy th..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must draft a bill to destroy the power of the judiciary."
entries.menuText: “We must draft a bill to destroy the power of the judiciary."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Taking away the legislative power..."
entries.dialogueText: “Taking away the legislative power of the Supreme Court while holding your own absolute authority over legislation would look like an attempt to consolidate your own power."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes. The divisions of power need t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The divisions of power need to be rebalanced for a better Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fair enough. Let's work with the r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough. Let's work with the reformists."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We can handle it, just like the pr..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can handle it, just like the previous governments did."
entries.menuText: “We can handle it, just like the previous governments did."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“True, we can't do it. It is too da..."
entries.dialogueText: “True, we can't do it. It is too dangerous."
entries.menuText: “True, we can't do it. It is too dangerous."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must draft a bill with more exe..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, I will only support a new cons..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I will only support a new constitution that strengthens my position. Forget the reformists and reach out to the NFP instead."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It will be a dangerous path to fol..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be a dangerous path to follow."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I can handle them. It will be done..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can handle them. It will be done under the Rayne administration."
entries.menuText: “I can handle them. It will be done under the Rayne administration."

entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Why would you want to work with th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why would you want to work with the Old Guard?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Without the Sollists' support, we..."
entries.dialogueText: “Without the Sollists' support, we have no power."
entries.menuText: “Without the Sollists' support, we have no power."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Keeping your absolute veto over le..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keeping your absolute veto over legislation but taking away the Supreme Court's influence over the Assembly would make it look like a power grab."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I need to maintain my powers.""
entries.dialogueText: “I need to maintain my powers."
entries.menuText: “I need to maintain my powers."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We can do it, Lucian! Look at what..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can do it, Lucian! Look at what we accomplished so far."
entries.menuText: “We can do it, Lucian! Look at what we accomplished so far."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The state is powerful as is. The q..."
entries.dialogueText: "The state is powerful as is. The question is how to approach these constitutional amendments and if it's realistic to pull off."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You're talking about going against..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're talking about going against the reformists and public opinion all at once."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. Vice President has a point.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vice President has a point."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I understand. We do not have to re..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. We do not have to remove your veto. Instead, we can discuss limiting it with the reformists."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I don't know if we can survive tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know if we can survive that politically."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you suggest we do then? Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: “What do you suggest we do then? Maybe I can reconsider working with the reformists."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. This is not happening. I'd rat..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. This is not happening. I'd rather not include either of these points."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want to minimize the damage to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to minimize the damage to my seat."
entries.menuText: "I want to minimize the damage to my seat."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have no problems with these clau..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have no problems with these clauses. Let's work with the reformists."
entries.menuText: “I have no problems with these clauses. Let's work with the reformists."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The President needs to be able to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The President needs to be able to exercise his powers with ease to maintain stability."
entries.menuText: "The President needs to be able to exercise his powers with ease to maintain stability."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must strengthen the state by re..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must strengthen the state by removing the power of the Old Guard."
entries.menuText: "We must strengthen the state by removing the power of the Old Guard."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The real problem is the judiciary'..."
entries.dialogueText: “The real problem is the judiciary's power, not the president's."
entries.menuText: “The real problem is the judiciary's power, not the president's."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes. Of course I'm with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Of course I'm with you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need to address other more impo..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to address other more important problems, too."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What is the best outcome for us th..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is the best outcome for us then?"
entries.menuText: “What is the best outcome for us then?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""If you are serious about this, I w..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you are serious about this, I will explore the options for you, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“To clarify before we head in any p..."
entries.dialogueText: “To clarify before we head in any particular direction, what are your intentions, sir?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The public might be persuaded, but..."
entries.dialogueText: “The public might be persuaded, but the reformists in the Assembly are not going to fall for that."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“They would try to paint you as yet..."
entries.dialogueText: “They would try to paint you as yet another strongman trying to grab more power for himself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you suggest, Lucian?""
entries.dialogueText: “What do you suggest, Lucian?"
entries.menuText: “What do you suggest, Lucian?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It would be quite difficult to sec..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be quite difficult to secure the 166 votes needed to propose such a bill."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What about you, Petr?""
entries.dialogueText: “What about you, Petr?"
entries.menuText: “What about you, Petr?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It will be very difficult to plead..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be very difficult to plead that case to the reformists."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Anton, we got elected by promising..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, we got elected by promising democratic reforms."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That would be tough, sir. But I tr..."
entries.dialogueText: “That would be tough, sir. But I trust your judgement."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We would lose all reformist suppor..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would lose all reformist support."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That does include strengthening th..."
entries.dialogueText: "That does include strengthening the Assembly by giving them a chance to override vetoes, as well as ensuring that the judiciary is independent."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We don't need the reformists. We c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't need the reformists. We can always work with the NFP."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As you wish. We will move forward..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish. We will move forward on that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We can package it as a *democratic..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can package it as a *democratic* reform.”
entries.menuText: “We can package it as a *democratic* reform.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“However, most people will not be p..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, most people will not be persuaded by that. It would be tough to reach the 166 votes needed to propose such a bill."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You're right. Let's work with the..."
entries.dialogueText: “You're right. Let's work with the reformists."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No matter what you say, I intend t..."
entries.dialogueText: “No matter what you say, I intend to come out of this stronger as the President.”
entries.menuText: “No matter what you say, I intend to come out of this stronger as the President.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well... Let's see what we can do a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... Let's see what we can do about it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I somewhat agree with you, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: “I somewhat agree with you, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What everyone's expecting is a reb..."
entries.dialogueText: "What everyone's expecting is a rebalance of power between the executive, legislative and judiciary branches."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Of course. We'll have time to disc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. We'll have time to discuss everything you want."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If it must be done, I will do it.""
entries.dialogueText: “If it must be done, I will do it."
entries.menuText: “If it must be done, I will do it."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The reformists are pretty loud abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reformists are pretty loud about their thoughts on the presidential powers, Anton. You know they think this position breeds dictators."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can't we avoid strengthening the A..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can't we avoid strengthening the Assembly?"
entries.menuText: “Can't we avoid strengthening the Assembly?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“According to the initial draft we..."
entries.dialogueText: “According to the initial draft we made with the reformists, there are two changes to the Constitution that are not open for their discussion."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I see that. But we will move towar..."
entries.dialogueText: “I see that. But we will move towards this direction for now."
entries.menuText: “I see that. But we will move towards this direction for now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't care what they think. We c..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't care what they think. We can handle them."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“First, the Supreme Court will no l..."
entries.dialogueText: “First, the Supreme Court will no longer vote on constitutional amendments."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The entire process will take a lon..."
entries.dialogueText: “The entire process will take a long time. But we must start working with a reform committee to evaluate all possibilities for a new Constitution as soon as possible.”

entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We will form a reform committee to..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will form a reform committee together with all parties and start reaching out to all the stakeholders in the Assembly and the Court for a new Constitution."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We will form a reform committee an..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will form a reform committee and start talking with all stakeholders in the Assembly and the Court to see if such changes to the Constitution would be possible."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Let us at least work with a reform..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let us at least work with a reform committee to start talking with all stakeholders in the Assembly and the Court just to query opinions. I'll try to reach out to the Old Guard, in the meantime."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""By later in the year, we should ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "By later in the year, we should have an idea of the reform contents and what the other parties want."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""By later in the year, we should kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "By later in the year, we should know more about the reform contents and how to balance the clauses of the new Constitution."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""By later in the year, we should ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "By later in the year, we should have an idea about the reform contents and what the other parties want. Then we can decide whether to pull the trigger."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our party must fall in line with o..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our party must fall in line with our position. We can't have a strong divide."
entries.menuText: “Our party must fall in line with our position. We can't have a strong divide."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The USP reformists aren't wrong to..."
entries.dialogueText: “The USP reformists aren't wrong to agree that we need change, but we should be in charge."
entries.menuText: “The USP reformists aren't wrong to agree that we need change, but we should be in charge."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We can't let the PFJP leadership t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't let the PFJP leadership take the spotlight on this."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""True. If our party fractures, it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "True. If our party fractures, it's the opposition that will benefit."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Mr. Ricter could be a potential al..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Ricter could be a potential ally in our goal to maintain a majority in the Assembly."
entries.menuText: “Mr. Ricter could be a potential ally in our goal to maintain a majority in the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“He's definitely key in this.""
entries.dialogueText: “He's definitely key in this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr looked troubled."
entries.dialogueText: Petr looked troubled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr nodded in agreement."
entries.dialogueText: Petr nodded in agreement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Petr shook his head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian scratched his head."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian scratched his head.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I won't be bought, it won't happen..."
entries.dialogueText: “I won't be bought, it won't happen.”
entries.menuText: “I won't be bought, it won't happen.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will enter a dialogue with them..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will enter a dialogue with them eventually. We need to be diplomatic.”
entries.menuText: “I will enter a dialogue with them eventually. We need to be diplomatic.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“However, to reform the constitutio..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, to reform the constitution we must receive a two-thirds majority in the Grand National Assembly, which is 166 votes. *And* a simple majority in the Supreme Court that equates to 6 votes.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“After we have settled on how to pr..."
entries.dialogueText: “After we have settled on how to proceed, we will need to talk with our party figures. Our first goal must be to get the 150 signatures needed to start the process.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: “Of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at his watch."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at his watch.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Well then, gentlemen. Precisely 30..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well then, gentlemen. Precisely 30 minutes.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Talk to you soon, sir. I will keep..."
entries.dialogueText: “Talk to you soon, sir. I will keep in touch.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“See you both at the next meeting.”"
entries.dialogueText: “See you both at the next meeting.”

entries.dialogueText: “Following the greenlight from the USP, we will reach out to the other party leaders to see if they would back our draft. The last step is to convince the justices of the Court.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr's eyes sparkled. The strain of..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr's eyes sparkled. The strain of the past months had put a damper on his usual rakish charm, but today he was looking and acting more like his old self. He loosened his tie and undid the top two buttons of his shirt.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Enjoying the new secretary I picke..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enjoying the new secretary I picked out for you? Thought you'd appreciate her gorgeous set of... talents. It's a shame the rest of your staff aren't as easy on the eyes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured to the slight paunch th..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured to the slight paunch that protruded over his waistband.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian spoke in soft, clipped tones..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian spoke in soft, clipped tones that immediately drew your attention towards what he had to say. Petr and I waited for him to proceed.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We did it Anton, we won! Finally!..."
entries.dialogueText: “We did it Anton, we won! Finally! The bribery, the backstabbing -- it's all paid off."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Our election campaign promised to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our election campaign promised to focus on the military. This was a safe choice. The military and the general staff are a powerful element in the state, and as history tells us, a dangerous one too.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The military and the general staff..."
entries.dialogueText: “The military and the general staff are a powerful element in the state, and as history tells us, a dangerous one too. We do have some room to make structural changes -- by reducing their budget, for example. But it is quite limited."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I want to work with them anyway. T..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to work with them anyway. The new administration will be open to talk to businessmen.”
entries.menuText: “I want to work with them anyway. The new administration will be open to talk to businessmen.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The military can be close allies...."
entries.dialogueText: “The military can be close allies. And with the Rumburg threat on the horizon, we need them.”
entries.menuText: “The military can be close allies. And with the Rumburg threat on the horizon, we need them.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The Sordish Armed Forces represent..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Sordish Armed Forces represent our pride as a nation and will be funded as promised.”
entries.menuText: “The Sordish Armed Forces represent our pride as a nation and will be funded as promised.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“With the Rumburg threat on the hor..."
entries.dialogueText: “With the Rumburg threat on the horizon, we can't reduce our defense capability and anger our General Staff.”
entries.menuText: “With the Rumburg threat on the horizon, we can't reduce our defense capability and anger our General Staff.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The military has been nothing but..."
entries.dialogueText: “The military has been nothing but a burden on our society. We should do something drastic -- like cutting their funding.”
entries.menuText: “The military has been nothing but a burden on our society. We should do something drastic -- like cutting their funding.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If they prove to be a political th..."
entries.dialogueText: “If they prove to be a political threat in the future, we can get rid of them.”
entries.menuText: “If they prove to be a political threat in the future, we can get rid of them.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Rumburg is a massive threat. One t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg is a massive threat. One that also requires us to ally with other, stronger nations.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That will ensure they will be on o..."
entries.dialogueText: “That will ensure they will be on our side unless we do something drastic in the course of our term.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I would advise the same. The budge..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would advise the same. The budget should be maintained and we should refrain from confronting the military too directly.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That is possible, but we can be su..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is possible, but we can be sure that there will be a strong negative reaction. If we push the military too far, it could cause real trouble.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Bold strategy Mr. President. One t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Bold strategy Mr. President. One that could work, but we would need to amend the constitution first. Let's not get ahead of ourselves.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“If we act strongly against the mil..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we act strongly against the military, both of those guys will unite against us. I agree with Lucian. We need to tread carefully here."
